description: Estimated fast pusher installation standing in for the ducted fan of 1.45-2.2 m electric park jets: 28 mm class 1900 rpm/V outrunner, ideal ESC, 4S 2.2 Ah LiPo and a 6x4.5 pusher propeller in a slot behind the wing. Tuned with the runtime electric solver to the static thrust of a 4S 70 mm EDF (about 16 N, 1.6 kgf) with zero thrust near 54 m/s and a 221 m/s static tip speed; all values are engineering estimates, not a measured installation. Ducted-fan inlet, duct and exhaust effects are not modelled. Realism audit 2026-11-17: the 12x6 pusher limited jets to 23-33 m/s.

kv_rpm_per_volt.source: Engineering estimate for a 28 mm class 1900 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified); chosen so the static thrust matches a 4S 70 mm EDF (1.2-1.6 kgf)

resistance_ohm.source: Engineering estimate for a 28 mm class 1900 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified): winding resistance

no_load_current_a.source: Engineering estimate for a 28 mm class 1900 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified): no-load current

no_load_voltage_v.source: Engineering estimate for a 28 mm class 1900 rpm/V outrunner (no specific product verified): no-load test voltage

resistance_ohm.source: About 7 milliohm per cell for a 2200 mAh 35C pack (catalogue class)

auxiliary_current_a.source: Receiver, servos and retract electronics at rest

ocv_points.source: Donor propulsion.battery.ocv_points: linear 3.0 to 4.2 V per cell over state of charge (EL2a synthetic authored fixture, not a measured LiPo fit)

rotating_inertia.source: 6 g 6 in propeller as a slender rod m·D²/12 = 1.2e-5 plus a 28 mm motor bell

ct_table.source: Borrowed: nondimensional UIUC APC Sport 11x6 table (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt) applied to a 6x4.5 pusher (mirrored blades assumed equivalent) by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ and P = Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵: no UIUC table for this propeller is in the repository; P/D 0.75 against 0.55 and a lower chord Reynolds number make it an estimate

cp_table.source: Borrowed: nondimensional UIUC APC Sport 11x6 table (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt) applied to a 6x4.5 pusher (mirrored blades assumed equivalent) by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ and P = Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵: no UIUC table for this propeller is in the repository; P/D 0.75 against 0.55 and a lower chord Reynolds number make it an estimate

motor_behind_hub.source: Pusher: motor centre ahead of the propeller hub by a 0.01 m adapter plus half of a 0.04 m outrunner (applied forward)

firewall_behind_hub.source: Pusher: motor front face ahead of the propeller hub by a 0.01 m adapter plus a 0.04 m outrunner (applied forward)

spinner_length.source: Prop nut behind the hub, for the crash-hull tail point

6x4.5 propeller about 0.006 kg plus prop adapter
